lead: A button that asks "are you sure?" in a bubble before it does what it says: Delete, Merge, Archive. It is a [Button](/button) inside a [Popconfirm](/popconfirm), so it takes the props of Button, and `color="danger"` makes the bubble danger too. For the row actions of a table use the `confirm` of a [DataTable](/data-table) action.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: The confirm button of the bubble says what the button says.

danger.title: Danger
danger.description: `color="danger"` colours the button and the bubble; `description` says what follows.

async.title: Async confirm
async.description: `onConfirm` may return a promise: the bubble stays open with the confirm button loading, and closes when it is done.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: ConfirmButton has no slot of its own: the button is a [Button](/button) and the bubble a [Popconfirm](/popconfirm), styled by their stylesheets.
